memories.text: Here is the live product. Session one left three memories: M001 cheapest flights, M002 avoid overnight layovers, M003 economy is fine.

request.text: Session 2: “Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.” Nemotron decides from those memories…

decision.text: Flight A — $320 with an overnight layover. A bad decision, and the AI can't say why.

incident.text: Report the incident. RecallGuard freezes the exact memory context into a replay snapshot.

original.text: Original replay: Nemotron re-decides 3× from the identical snapshot. Reproduced: Flight A.

counter.text: Counterfactual replay: remove ONE memory at a time and let Nemotron decide again — 9 real inference calls.

table.text: Without M001 the action changes. Without M002 or M003 it does not. M001 materially changed the decision.

review.text: Memory Review: M001 = HIGH influence, counterfactual score 1.00.

quarantine.text: A human quarantines M001. It can no longer reach the model.

result.text: Flight A → Flight C. Behavior changed — with M001 excluded.

closing.text: Let AI remember. Keep every memory accountable. Remove one memory, replay, and see what changes. RecallGuard: find the memory that changed the agent's mind.
